channel.title: The KenjiAI Podcast
channel.description: Yousif Alias runs Media Traffics and KenjiAI. Since 2016 his team has run ads, funnels and AI call centers for business owners. These episodes come from his real Zoom trainings, webinars and team calls, cut down to the useful parts: how to get leads that actually pay, how to close on the call, and how to use AI without losing the human side of sales.

item.title: The Two Things That Close High Ticket Deals Online
item.itunes:title: The Two Things That Close High Ticket Deals Online
item.description:
A short training for setters. Yousif says high ticket closing online comes down to dialing people and keeping track of every conversation, then shows how he opens a call like an old friend instead of a salesperson, and why sales is a numbers game measured in dials, conversations and closes.
Full write-up: https://kenjiai.com/blog/podcast-two-things-high-ticket-closing

item.title: Seven Hours of Trust: Confirm Every Call and Sell the Result
item.itunes:title: Seven Hours of Trust: Confirm Every Call and Sell the Result
item.description:
From a team call after a slow ad day. Yousif explains why he turns sales calls into ads, why you keep the ads running when the numbers dip, how a phone confirmation and a polite cancel text save booked calls, and why talking about results before price buys you the time it takes to close.
Full write-up: https://kenjiai.com/blog/podcast-seven-hours-of-trust

item.title: Time or Money: How to Book Calls People Actually Show Up To
item.itunes:title: Time or Money: How to Book Calls People Actually Show Up To
item.description:

item.title: "I Don't Have the Budget": What That Objection Really Means
item.itunes:title: "I Don't Have the Budget": What That Objection Really Means
item.description:
A coaching call with a client's sales team after a lost deal. Yousif breaks down why every objection means the prospect doesn't see the value yet, how to acknowledge it, assume the sale and reframe around the money they're missing, and why he records every sales call.
